login-page.description: Public login page with one visible RUT input, one visible password input, and one native submit.

device-offer.description: Optional device-registration offer after acceptance; only the Omitir / Omitir por ahora control is ever used.

relay.description: Empty LoginJSFGenerico relay; neither success nor failure until the selector probe.

business-selector.description: Acceptance evidence: at least one business row on the convention selector.

successConditions: device offer, convention selector rows, dashboard frame, or a unique Mis Movimientos control establishes acceptance
stopConditions: rejection or ambiguity before acceptance trips the profile breaker
CAPTCHA, MFA, Turnstile, rate limit, or block
